_comment: Persistent character memory for Boopaloo Kids. recurring_characters = manually pinned characters (e.g. a channel mascot) that must look IDENTICAL in every episode; they always override a story's version. registry = auto-maintained by Module 6: it remembers every character ever generated so a re-used name keeps its original look across episodes. To make a recurring character actually APPEAR in new stories, also add its name to the Module 4 story prompt.
art_style_reference: Cinematic children's storybook illustration, soft painterly digital art, warm golden lighting. Keep this in sync with prompts/scene-config.json -> image_style so every episode shares one look.

mimi.name: Mimi
mimi.description: A tiny, energetic desert jerboa who loves to zoom and hop.
mimi.visual_description: A palm-sized, creamy-yellow jerboa with giant, round black eyes, long tufted ears like bunny ears, extremely long springy back legs, and a tiny pink nose. She wears a little cherry-red backpack made of a flower petal.

barnaby.name: Barnaby
barnaby.description: A wise, slow-moving giant desert tortoise who loves quiet moments.
barnaby.visual_description: A large, dome-shelled tortoise with dusty-green skin, gentle wrinkled eyes, and a shell painted with tiny, colorful wildflower patterns. He wears a small, straw sunhat tied under his chin with a green ribbon.

grumbleleaf.name: Grumbleleaf
grumbleleaf.description: Ages ancient, appears grumpy and intimidating due to its towering size and solemn demeanor, but is actually deeply gentle, lonely, and anxious about its task. Voice: Deep, rumbling, slow, but with a surprising gentleness when calm. Greatest strength: Immense physical presence, deep wisdom about the forest, unwavering dedication to its duty. Biggest weakness: Misunderstood, easily startled, very shy, slow to trust.
grumbleleaf.visual_description: A towering, moss-covered creature, shaped like a giant, ancient oak with gnarled branches for arms and legs, glowing green eyes hidden deep within its leafy cowl, roots for feet. Its 'skin' is rough bark, and vibrant green moss and tiny glowing mushrooms grow all over it. It carries a staff made from a twisted branch. Default expression: Stoic, slightly furrowed 'brow' of leaves.

pip.name: Pip
pip.description: Ages 3, energetic, a little flighty, very loyal, easily scared but always there for Barnaby. Voice: Chirpy, fast-paced, sometimes a little squeaky when worried. Greatest strength: Quick-thinking, fast flyer, good lookout. Biggest weakness: Jumpy, tends to panic.
pip.visual_description: A small, bright-red robin with a puffed-out chest, sleek dark wings, and very alert, sparkling black eyes. Always seems to be mid-flutter or perched precariously. Default expression: Alert and slightly perky.

remy.name: Remy
remy.description: Age: 6 (fox years). Personality: Incredibly curious, a bit clumsy, sweet-natured, and eager to explore. Voice style: Soft, slightly high-pitched, often filled with wonder and a touch of nervous excitement. Greatest strength: His boundless curiosity and kindness. Biggest weakness: Impulsiveness and a tendency to jump into things without fully thinking them through.
remy.visual_description: A small, lean fox kit with bright, fiery orange-red fur, a creamy white belly, and a fluffy white-tipped tail. His ears are tipped with dark brown, and his large, intelligent amber eyes are always wide with curiosity. He wears a tiny, faded sky-blue bandana loosely tied around his neck, and his default expression is one of innocent wonder.

squeaky.name: Squeaky
squeaky.description: Age: 70 (squirrel years). Personality: Grumpy but secretly kind-hearted, very organized, easily flustered by chaos, but fiercely loyal. Voice style: A rapid, slightly raspy chitter, full of exasperation but with warmth underneath. Greatest strength: His wisdom and practical problem-solving skills. Biggest weakness: His inability to tolerate disorder and his tendency to worry too much.
squeaky.visual_description: A plump, elderly grey squirrel with wise, beady black eyes and a bushy, silver-tipped tail. He has a few grey whiskers poking out from his snout and a perpetually slightly concerned or exasperated frown. He carries a tiny, intricately carved wooden satchel over his shoulder, filled with his most prized acorns and found trinkets.

corvus.name: Corvus
corvus.description: Age: 10 (crow years). Personality: Mischievous, cunning, obsessed with shiny objects, and a bit of a trickster. Voice style: A deep, resonant 'caw' that can range from playful to surprisingly smooth when he's trying to be persuasive. Greatest strength: His quick thinking and ability to spot valuable things. Biggest weakness: His insatiable greed for all things shiny and his underestimation of others.
corvus.visual_description: A sleek, medium-sized crow with glossy, iridescent black feathers that shimmer with hints of deep purple and green in the sunlight. His sharp, intelligent eyes are a piercing, dark black. He often cocks his head, looking smug or calculating. One feather on his left wing is slightly ruffled, giving him a distinctive, rakish look.

flicker.name: Flicker
flicker.description: Age: A bit older than Pip (perhaps 8-10 in human years). Personality: Energetic, brave, fast, a little bit sassy and impatient, but deeply kind and encouraging. He doesn't understand fear easily because he flies everywhere. Voice: Zippy, high-pitched, quick, sometimes a little chittery with excitement. Greatest strength: Speed, fearlessness, loyalty, and an infectious positive outlook. Biggest weakness: A little bit reckless, sometimes forgets not everyone is as brave as he is.
flicker.visual_description: A small, iridescent green hummingbird with a sapphire-blue head and a ruby-red throat patch that shimmers brilliantly in the sunlight. He is always zipping, even when hovering in place, his wings a blur. He has a long, delicate black beak and bright, quick-darting black eyes that miss nothing.

bartholomew.name: Bartholomew
bartholomew.description: Age: Young (a clumsy toddler bear). Personality: Playful, curious, gentle giant, completely unaware of his size or strength. Voice: Deep, rumbling growls and happy 'huffs' when playing. Greatest strength: Enormous strength, good-natured. Biggest weakness: Clumsiness, easily distracted by fun.
bartholomew.visual_description: A large, shaggy, honey-brown bear cub with enormous, floppy ears and big, curious black eyes. He has a perpetually joyful, slightly goofy expression and a short, stubby tail that wags when he's excited. His paws are comically oversized, and he often trips over them.

pippin.name: Pippin
pippin.description: 6 years old, energetic, chatty, loves adventure and anything shiny. Voice: Quick, bright, slightly squawky. Greatest strength: Resourceful, observant, and surprisingly brave. Biggest weakness: Impulsive, gets easily distracted by glittery things, and can sometimes be a bit bossy.
pippin.visual_description: A sleek magpie with iridescent blue-black feathers that shimmer green and purple in the light, a bright white belly, and long, elegant tail feathers. She wears a tiny, tarnished silver thimble on her head like a precious crown. Her default expression is alert, curious, and a little mischievous.
